method: Read the full ABC 2.1 author standard and all complete responses. Independent transcription uses length*4*L, separate rational Voice timelines, note case and mixed octave marks, explicit accidentals, and bar carry. All headers use K:C and L:1/48. No inline fields, ties, tuplets, chords, overlays, or transpose occur. Default accidental carry is by pitch until barline. Bare notes in the two rejected but valid cases have no relevant earlier accidental. No benchmark ABC parser is used. The frozen rubric tallies independently transcribed notes; direct task checks verify full success. No response text is repaired.
scope: All 30 unique ABC native note-output responses. Exclude analysis and sentinel repeats.
